LESSON: KUANDIKA 6.3.1 INSHA YA WASIFU

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha
2. kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia sifa zake

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia sifa zake
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia sifa zake. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha
2. kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia sifa zake

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
